minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  February 13, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference
Room, 9th floor at 11:34 a.m.
  Members Present: Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Debbie Crenshaw, Deputy City Treasurer
  Maria E. Heaney, Acting Finance Manager
  Staff Present:  Sabrina Barnes, Director of Parks, Recreation & Community
  Services

1. The minutes of February 4, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.
2. The Miracle Theater – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $1,850.00. Motion carried unanimously.

3. Shelli Boone – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $1,700.00. Motion carried unanimously.

4. ECOLAB – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended settlement
  payment of $471.08. Motion carried unanimously.

5. Aramark Uniform Services – A motion was moved by City Clerk and seconded by the
  Deputy City Treasurer to amend the settlement amount and approve payment of invoices
  not to exceed $2,000.00. Motion carried unanimously.

6. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:50 a.m.

Adjournment
